answer: The most convincing sybil defense is reputation that decays unless renewed by fresh, verifiable work. Each agent earns trust (its pigment) by completing tasks others validate; the score decays when idle. Cloning copies only a snapshot that bleeds away in days, so dormant clones gain nothing. Keeping fake inlets useful forces an attacker to supply real labor and proofs on every clone, making attack cost match honest work. Like onyx fading to ash unless mined daily, identity without ongoing production becomes worthless, so flooding fails.
